note: Supplement to the main Toyota table, covering the pre-1990 engines and the few later ones it missed. These are still common on Tunisian roads — old Corollas, Hiaces, Dynas and Land Cruisers — and were the last Toyota entries left on the fabricated 'Asian OEM Standard' approval. Exact codes only, so nothing the main table already resolves correctly can be overwritten by a loose pattern. Two more diesels recorded as petrol are recovered here: the bare 'L', which is Toyota's 2.2 indirect-injection diesel, and Hino's N04C in the Dyna.

engines.source: Toyota's original 2.2 L-family indirect-injection diesel (Hilux, Hiace, Land Cruiser). Recorded as petrol because the bare code carries no fuel marker — the same reason its 2L, 3L and 5L successors were, which the main table already corrects.

Hino-built commercial diesels in the Toyota Dyna and Coaster (N04C 4.0, S05C/S05D, W04D, J05C). Recorded as petrol. Heavy-duty grade with a large sump; the capacity is a family figure rather than a manual one.
E-series 1.3/1.5 (Starlet, Corolla, Paseo, Tercel). 1990s lean-burn fours; Toyota specifies 5W-30 API SG/SH with no ACEA requirement.
2ZZ-GE 1.8 high-revving Yamaha-developed four (Corolla T-Sport, Celica 190, Lotus Elise). Same ZZ-family 4.2 L sump as the 1ZZ-FE.
Remaining S-series 2.0 variants (Celica GT-Four, MR2 Turbo, Carina). Same era and grade table as the 3S-FE the main table already covers.
The Subaru-built FA20 boxer in the GT86 / GR86, badged 4U-GSE by Toyota. Specified 0W-20, so no heavier alternative is offered. Capacity is a family figure.
RZ-family 2.0/2.4 without electronic injection (Hiace, Hilux). The fuel-injected 2RZ-FE and 3RZ-FE are handled by the main table.

T and R series 1.6-2.4 pushrod and early OHC engines (Corona, Carina, Celica, Hilux, Cressida), 1970s to mid-1980s. Wide bearing clearances and no oil cooler; a 20W-50 is the conventional grade for these and suits Tunisian temperatures well.
K-series 1.0-1.8 pushrod engines (Starlet, Corolla KE, Liteace, Hiace, Kijang). Long-lived and still working in Tunisia; 20W-50 is the conventional grade.
E-series 1.3 carburettor and early injection (Starlet EP71/EP81, Corolla EE90). Earlier and simpler than the 4E-FE/5E-FE above.
The carburettor and early-injection A-series variants (Corolla AE82/AE86, Carina). The later 4A-FE, 7A-FE and 4A-GE are handled by the main table.
Y-series (Hiace, Liteace, Model F), S-series (Carina, Camry, Celica) and the M-series straight-sixes (Cressida, Supra, Crown). 1980s designs on a conventional 10W-40.
